body: Mateus Andrade is the subject of active negotiations between Bayern Munich and Flamengo, with personal terms reportedly already agreed on a five-year deal. Both clubs are described as prioritizing the winger, with formal talks now open.

findings.evidence_quote: Bayern Munich and Flamengo are negotiating the fee, with personal terms already agreed on a five-year deal for the winger.
Bayern Munich's board have opened formal negotiations with Flamengo and see the Brazilian as their top target.
